provenance.author: Michel de Messieres
provenance.method: exact rank-2 exclusion over the 36,720 four-qubit stabilizer states after compressing |cat_5> into the even-weight code Z^5 = +1

llm.role: designed, wrote and ran the certificate and its cross-checks

notes: Machine check of Lemma 3 in the appendix of Qassim, Pashayan, and Gosset (arXiv:2106.07740), chi(cat_5) > 2, which they prove by a computer comparison of Pauli spectra; the rank is theirs, the check is new. With bounds/cat-m5-upper-3.json the cell is exact, chi(cat_5) = 3, as in their Table 1. Method: |cat_5> lies in the stabilizer code Z^{(x)5} = +1, and projecting a decomposition onto that code keeps each term a stabilizer state or zero; the CNOT chain onto the last qubit identifies the code with four qubits, so chi(cat_5) is the rank of the four-qubit state c_5(y) = cat_5(y, parity(y)), whose entries are fourth roots of unity. All 36,720 four-qubit stabilizer states are generated exactly as Gaussian-integer vectors (count asserted). With q(s) = s - s_0 t, exact over Z[i], the target lies in the span of two states iff their quotients are parallel, decided by exact reduced Gaussian-rational keys; no floating point enters the decision. Controls in the script: compressed cat_4 (chi = 2) shows its 15 rank-2 classes, a stabilizer target is flagged as rank 1, and the closed form of |cat_m> matches stabrank_verify.cat_vector exactly for m = 4, 5, 6. About 8 s on one core.
